# Vizzie

> Vizzie is a free, web-based tool for visualising and mapping open data — connected to
> 280+ open-data portals across 40+ countries, with licence-cleared boundaries and no
> GIS skills required. The app is at https://app.vizzie.org (works without an account).

## Linking into the app

- [Deep links](https://www.vizzie.org/link.md): the URL grammar that opens Vizzie
  already searching open data for a place (#find=), drawing a census map (#census=),
  or previewing a dataset (#dataset=) — with working examples.

## Reference

- [Open data portals](https://www.vizzie.org/portals/): every portal Vizzie connects
  to — live dataset counts, platforms, and per-portal licence observations.
- [Geography reference](https://www.vizzie.org/geography/): the boundary levels Vizzie
  joins data to (census tracts, SA2s, LSOAs, NUTS and more), with counts, vintages and
  licences.
- [Brand and boilerplate](https://www.vizzie.org/brand/): logo files and the company
  boilerplate, free to use in coverage.
